title: estimator double-submit idempotency and production draft date/shift isolation

targeted_review_fix.finding: PROD-022 review found that production draft keys were only scoped by date and shift, so same-browser drafts could cross org/user boundaries after logout/login or account switch.
targeted_review_fix.fix: Production draft keys now include org_id, userId, date, and shift when profile context is available. The supervisor dashboard passes userProfile.org_id and userProfile.userId to the draft-key helper and skips localStorage draft reads/writes until a scoped key exists.

exact_row_definitions_inspected.current_failure_evidence: Estimator save and market-run creation are not idempotent at the server boundary. saveEstimatorQuoteV3 unconditionally inserts a new estimator_quote per call. createMarketRunFromEstimator separately inserts an estimator_quote, market_run, and backing order without an idempotency key or single transaction. Rapid duplicate server-action calls can create duplicate quotes/runs/orders even if the UI disables the button after React state updates.
exact_row_definitions_inspected.implementation_type: UI/client submit guard; durable server-action idempotency would require a safe persisted idempotency key or database/RPC design and was not implemented in this no-migration batch.
exact_row_definitions_inspected.migration_or_rpc_needed: Not for the UI guard implemented here. Durable server-boundary idempotency remains future product/database design work.

exact_row_definitions_inspected.expected_behavior: Draft stored under correct date/shift and never submitted to another shift.
exact_row_definitions_inspected.current_failure_evidence: Entered loom values remained visible when changing the date, then the date reset to June 22 on save; draft isolation by date was not reliable or clearly communicated.

In QA/browser, enter loom values on one org/user/date/shift, change date and shift, verify other selections do not show those values, return to the original date/shift and verify the matching draft restores, switch account/org in the same browser to verify drafts do not cross identity boundaries, then save and verify the submitted production rows use the currently selected date/shift.
